{{Quote|Junction...?! ''We'' know that place! Since the ''Imperial blockade...'' it's one of Yavin Base's chief source of ''supplies''.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 33">[[Star Wars (1977) 33|''Star Wars'' (1977) 33]]</ref>}}
'''Feriae Junction''' (often simply called "'''Junction'''") was a tradeworld at the nexus of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], the [[Thesme Trace]], and the [[Gordian Reach (hyperspace route)|Gordian Reach]].

==History==
Located at the nexus of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], the [[Gordian Reach (hyperspace route)|Gordian Reach]], and the [[Thesme Trace]], Junction was a run-down but busy trade world where the hand of law enforcement rested lightly and «no questions asked» was the rule. Yet reminders of better times were still visible in the center of [[Junction City]]. Chief among them was the sprawling [[Grand Terminal]], through which those arriving and departing the planet were funneled.<ref name="WZ">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030724takedown|text=Zygerrian Takedown|int=Zygerrian Takedown}}</ref>

A [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-controlled company was located on the world and maintained an account for transferring money from the shipping magnat [[Brevis Taug]] to the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Thanda clan]].<ref name="WZ" />

Junction was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEA" />

During a boom in demand for [[Corusca gem/Legends|Corusca gems]] from [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], Junction flourished briefly before the tourist industry sputtered out. It was the running point for [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] members fleeing the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] saved [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] from being killed by [[Beilert Valance/Legends|Beilert Valance]] on this planet.<ref name="marvel27" />

After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Feriae Junction was integrated in [[Warlord of the Empire|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s [[Zsinj's Empire|Empire]]. After his death in the [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|Battle of Dathomir]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Teren Rogriss|Rogriss]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[High Admiral]] [[Treuten Teradoc|Teradoc]] of the [[Greater Maldrood]] moved into Zsinj's former territory to capture what they could. Rogriss was [[Battle of Junction|beaten]] by [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] Teradoc at Junction for the control of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]].<ref name="TEA" />

Admiral Rogriss took advantage of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Post–Zsinj campaigns|campaign]] against Teradoc and its [[Battle of Centares (Galactic Civil War)|defeat]] at [[Centares/Legends|Centares]] to reintegrate a part of the Greater Maldrood in the Empire, including Feriae Junction.<ref name="TEA" />
